signature: _base_score(name, idents, body_words, exc_types, body_lines, signals) -> float
pre_condition: name is a non-empty string. idents is a set of lowercase identifier strings extracted from the function. body_words is a set of lowercase word strings from the function body. exc_types is a set of lowercase exception-type name strings. body_lines is a positive integer representing the number of source lines in the function body. signals is a dict of pre-parsed signal token sets keyed by signal category; each value is a set of lowercase string tokens. signals must contain keys for traceback functions, backtick identifiers, dotted references, plain identifiers, all-words, and exception types.
post_condition: Returns a non-negative float equal to the sum of weighted token-match contributions across multiple independent signal categories. The function name is decomposed into lowercase parts, and each part is tested for exact membership in distinct signal sets, with each set contributing a fixed per-match weight: backtick-identifier overlap contributes a weight higher than body-level backtick overlap; dotted-reference overlap contributes the highest per-match weight among identifier categories; plain-identifier overlap contributes a moderate weight; all-words overlap from name-parts is limited to parts of at least 5 characters and contributes a low weight. The full name is tested case-insensitively against traceback-function signals with the highest single-match weight. Identifiers in idents are tested against backtick-identifier signals with moderate per-match weight. Exception types in exc_types are tested for exact membership in exception-type signals with moderate per-match weight. Body words in body_words are tested against all-words signals, and the raw overlap count is divided by the square root of body_lines before multiplying by the lowest per-match weight. A fuzzy string-similarity match between name parts and identifier-like signal tokens contributes a bounded additional term, requiring both strings to exceed a minimum character-length threshold and a similarity exceeding a fixed ratio threshold. Each component is independent and adds additively to the total. The return value is deterministic: identical arguments always produce identical results. The result is zero when no metadata facet matches any signal token in any category and body_words shares no tokens with all-words signals.
